company_name: Sany Heavy Equipment International Holdings Company Limited

equity_bridge.item: Non-current FVTPL unlisted investments (LP and LLC stakes)
equity_bridge.note: H1 2026 interim note 13, at fair value; income from them is not in the EBITDA anchor

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 11.0% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 27.0% (and EPS 3yr 1.4%): revenue growth has come from acquisitions (lithium Jul-2024) and lower-margin mix (mining trucks, port machinery, batteries) while EBITDA margin fell from ~25% (FY2019) to ~13-15%. Revenue growth is NOT a proxy for value growth here.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - P&L interest income): FY2020 632.7, FY2021 -93.2, FY2022 -222.2, FY2023 -135.9, FY2024 887.8, FY2025 760.3 (RMB m). 3yr CAGR not meaningful (negative base). Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR 3.7% vs reported 11.7%: SBC and interest income on a growing cash pile account for a rising share of reported FCF.

scenario_narratives.base: Mining trucks (H1 2026 +97.5%) and large port machinery (+62.6%) keep carrying growth, overseas sales pass half of revenue, and the domestic coal-machinery franchise erodes slowly rather than collapsing. Revenue reaches ~RMB28bn in FY2026 and compounds at mid-single digits thereafter -- roughly 60% of the way to management's RMB57.5bn 2028 target by FY2028. The mix shift that has cut the EBITDA margin from ~25% to ~13% since FY2019 stops but does not reverse: ~12.5% operating EBITDA, no move toward the 24% gross-margin target. Receivables stay near 190 days, so every RMB of growth still absorbs ~30 fen of working capital, and owner FCF converts only part of reported profit.
scenario_narratives.bull: The globalisation strategy works: overseas mining trucks and electric port equipment (APM Terminals 500+ tractor framework as the reference customer) scale with pricing power, lithium/energy storage grows into a profitable segment rather than a cash sink, and unmanned-mining solutions earn a software-like premium. Revenue compounds at 15-18% for two years (~RMB38bn by FY2028 -- still well short of the 57.5bn target) and the operating EBITDA margin recovers to ~14.5%, consistent with gross margin approaching the 24% goal. Receivable discipline seen in H1 2026 (190 vs 204 days) holds, so working-capital absorption falls to ~25% of incremental revenue.
scenario_narratives.bear: H1 2026 is the top of a cycle: China coal capex contracts under capacity curbs and a weaker coal price, overseas growth stalls on tariffs/procurement restrictions against Chinese exporters, and battery/solar price wars force write-downs in the emerging-industries segment. Revenue grows ~9% in FY2026 on the locked-in first half, then falls 8% and 5%. Margin compresses to ~9% as fixed costs deleverage, customer defaults trigger the RMB3bn of leasing guarantees and receivable impairments rise. A shrinking top line releases some working capital, but leverage (gearing 67%) caps dividends and the business only recovers to a ~10.5% margin at low growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Cyclical, working-capital-hungry Chinese capital-equipment maker valued on owner FCF, not earnings. Reported net income has been a poor guide to owner cash: FY2021-23 owner FCF was negative while NPAT was RMB1.3-1.9bn, because receivables, inventory and an emerging-industries capex programme absorbed the cash. The model therefore charges working capital on every RMB of growth, holds margins near today's compressed level in the base, and puts 30% weight on a cyclical downturn. All values computed in RMB and converted to HKD at the dated CNYHKD rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital capture: each 5pp change in the WC capture rate on incremental revenue moves near-term owner FCF by ~RMB150-200m/yr at base growth
EBITDA margin: the base holds ~12.5%; the 24% gross-margin target, if real, is worth materially more, and continued mix dilution materially less
Customer-finance guarantees (RMB3.05bn) and 190-day receivables convert into credit losses in a mining/port downturn
Parent control: Sany Group holds the 479.8m convertible preference shares and the related-party leasing companies; minority holders depend on arm's-length dealing
FX: RMB/HKD moves translate one-for-one into the HKD per-share value

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HKD 6.40-16.24
data_sources.financials: 0631.HK_Metrics.csv and core_metrics (FY2017-FY2025, H1 2023-2026); FY2025 annual report income statement and cash-flow statement; H1 2026 interim report balance sheet, notes 9 (EPS), 13 (FVTPL), 15 (borrowings), 16 (share capital, CPS), 19 (financial guarantees)

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 30 Jun 2026: 3,289.72m ordinary shares in issue + 479.78m convertible preference shares (convertible 1:1 at any time, rank pari passu for dividends; held by the Sany Group parent) + ~23.3m dilutive options/awards (H1 2026 interim note 9: dilutive weighted shares 503.03m less 479.78m CPS) = ~3,793m. The CSV SharesOutstanding column is blank FY2023+ and the FY2017-22 values were ordinary-only; this count is sourced directly from 0631.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt notes 9 and 16. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. H1 2026 issued 57.3m new shares (26.0m options, 31.3m awards) -- that is the SBC dilution the flat count + SBC charge already prices.
inputs.net_debt_build: 30 Jun 2026 interim balance sheet (RMB m): interest-bearing bank and other borrowings 4,755.8 current + 6,556.3 non-current = 11,312.2; lease liabilities 37.9 + 128.4 = 166.3 (treatment A); dividend payable 815.7 (FY2025 final dividend declared, paid after the balance-sheet date; the stock now trades ex, so the cash is the outgoing shareholders' not the buyer's -- includes a HK$86m 2018 special dividend still unclaimed). Total debt-like 12,294.2. Less cash and cash equivalents 4,311.1 and current FVTPL bank wealth-management products 4,943.3 (note 13; liquid, bought with surplus cash -- H1 2026 investing outflow was mainly WMP purchases) = 9,254.4. Pledged deposits 336.9 EXCLUDED (collateral for bills payable, operating). Net debt 3,039.8. The company's own capital-management 'net debt' (RMB23.4bn FY2025) includes trade and other payables and is not this figure.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement 'Share option and share award expenses' RMB128,901k (0631.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt cash flow adjustments). No net-share-settlement withholding line in financing (HK awards are issued as new shares; EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year).
inputs.interest_income_note: P&L interest income RMB292.5m FY2025 deducted (only RMB179.9m of it is received inside OCF; deducting the full P&L figure is the conservative, consistent-with-history choice). Stripped because the full 9.25bn cash + WMP pile is credited in the bridge. FY2025 WMP fair-value gains of RMB142.3m are likewise excluded from the EBITDA anchor.
inputs.buyback_note: No buybacks since FY2021 (RMB6.1m). Non-repurchaser: the flat share count is a modelling convention the company is not funding -- it issues 1-2%/yr of new shares for options/awards.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate 1.1721 HKD per CNY, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-10T03:38Z. Cross-check via USD crosses (HKD=X 7.8472 / CNY=X 6.683 = 1.1742), a 0.2% tie. Direction check: the H1 2026 interim converts HK$171.2m option proceeds to RMB153.9m (1.112 HKD/CNY at the June rate) -- same direction, RMB has since appreciated. No dual listing of 0631 exists for a price parity check (600031.SH/6031.HK is the separate parent Sany Heavy Industry).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z (HKEX regular close, Friday; Yahoo chart API)
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB-built: China 10y CGB ~1.9% risk-free + beta ~1.2 (cyclical capital equipment) x ~6.5% China ERP = cost of equity ~9.7-10%; pre-tax borrowing cost 2-4% (interim note 15) -> ~2.3% after tax at ~10% net-debt weight of EV -> ~9.0-9.3%. Rounded up to 9.5% to reflect the HK-listed, parent-controlled (Sany Group) minority position; the same 9.5% in every scenario -- cyclicality and the margin path are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB166.3m in net debt; lease principal (RMB126m FY2025) NOT deducted from flows; ROU depreciation stays in D&A and ROU renewal is charged through the capex line. Most of the RMB1.33bn ROU asset is prepaid land-use rights with no ongoing liability.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is a deficit (-RMB65.7m equity at 30 Jun 2026; NCI took a RMB30.8m share of losses in FY2025), so attributable profit exceeds total profit. Flows are whole-group; no NCI deduction in the bridge. Immaterial (<0.3% of equity value) either way.
inputs.customer_finance_note: Routing check for a captive-finance arm: there is none. Customer financing runs through third-party and Sany Group leasing companies (Sany Financial Leasing, Kangfu, Fuhong, Zhonghong, Cinda, Industrial Bank Leasing, Sany Auto Finance) with Group guarantees and repurchase obligations: RMB3,048.5m outstanding at 30 Jun 2026 (RMB4,075.4m at Dec 2025), ECL allowance RMB64.2m. Off balance sheet and not a lending book, so the owner-FCF route holds. The guarantee is a contingent claim: it is NOT deducted in the bridge, but the bear case carries the credit-cost/margin hit it would produce in a downturn.
inputs.ebitda_anchor_note: FY2025 operating EBITDA (pre-SBC) built from the statutory P&L: PBT 2,178.5 + finance costs 252.9 - interest income 292.5 - WMP FV gain 142.3 + D&A 1,164.9 + goodwill/PPE impairment 95.2 + SBC 128.9 = 3,385.6 (13.9%). Less ~180m for government grants booked in income (474.8m) above cash received (295.3m) = ~3,205 (13.2%). Receivable impairments (217m) kept in as a recurring credit cost. H1 2026: PBT -8.7% YoY on revenue +20.5%, gross margin 22.1% vs 23.7%; H2 is seasonally far weaker (FY2025 H2 PBT only 471m of 2,178m), so the FY2026 base margin is set BELOW FY2025 at 12.0%.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (RMB flows vs HKD quote, lease treatment A, NCI, matching-asset rule for WMPs, risk charged once). Routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'Operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry, no prior DCF). Not a bank/lessor: customer finance is third-party with guarantees (see customer_finance_note). Owner FCF has been NEGATIVE in FY2021-23 and cumulative FY2021-25 owner FCF (~RMB1.2bn) is ~16% of cumulative net income (~RMB7.7bn): this is a working-capital and capex hungry grower, and the house value reflects that rather than earnings. Horizon 10 years. Working-capital capture NEGATIVE (FY2024 -35%, FY2025 -33% of revenue increase; receivables ~190 days).

bear.wc_capture_rationale: Deliberately LOWER magnitude than base (-30%): the engine applies one capture rate symmetrically, and at -35% the FY2027-28 revenue decline would release ~RMB1.2bn of working capital as if 190-day receivables and RMB3bn of guaranteed leases unwind cleanly in a downturn. They do not -- collections slow and impairments rise -- so the bear release is tempered to 20 fen per RMB of revenue lost.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +15%: H1 delivered +20.5% (RMB14.75bn); H2 at ~+10% on a weaker comparable gives ~RMB28.0bn. Then decelerates as mining trucks and port machinery mature and domestic coal machinery keeps shrinking; well short of the RMB57.5bn 2028 target (base reaches ~RMB34.8bn in FY2028).
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Mix shift to trucks, port and battery products has taken the margin down for six years; H1 2026 gross margin fell 1.6pp. Base holds ~12-12.5% (cash-grant-adjusted, ex interest) -- no recovery toward the 24% gross-margin target.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 gross capex 5.2% (net of RMB368m disposals 3.7%); H1 2026 only 1.8% as the emerging-industries build-out slows and capital commitments fall (RMB475m vs RMB700m). Settles at 4.0%, slightly above terminal D&A of 3.8%.
base.tax_rationale: Cash taxes paid / PBT: FY2023 19%, FY2025 23.5% (FY2024 36% on non-deductible impairments). Mix of 15% HNTE subsidiaries and 25% statutory -> 22%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: a highly cyclical capital-goods maker whose H1 2026 profit fell while revenue rose 20%, with gearing up from 63.2% to 67.1% in 18 months, a structurally declining legacy franchise, and RMB3bn of customer-finance guarantees. Base 50% as the central path. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things at once -- overseas scale, margin reversal against six years of mix dilution, and a profitable entry into overcapacity battery/solar markets.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.not_evaluated_reason: no rule had inputs: no annual row with revenue, equity or earnings on a known scale (core_metrics.units NULL? see make backfill-units) or no FY-end price aligned to it
